ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Predominantly low-intensity (black) surface area (~92%) with localized high-intensity (white) regions at the left distal tip and minor mottling along the superior margins.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Contiguous low-intensity region covering the central and right lobes; a distinct high-contrast white geometric blob is mapped to the distal ~15% of the left lobe. Discrete high-frequency white spots are visible along the upper trailing edge of the left lobe.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Deep V-shaped median notch with a calculated pixel angle of approximately 38 degrees and a vertical depth comprising ~12% of the visible vertical span.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency, irregular serrations with pixel-amplitudes between 4 and 10 units observed along the entire trailing edge boundary, isolated against the water background.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Bilateral convex curve fitted to the trailing edges of both lobes, tapering to acute distal points.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Multiple small, roughly circular high-contrast white pixel clusters (1-4 pixels in diameter) scattered across the dark pigmentation of both lobes.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: A single, unaligned diagonal linear disruption (~30 pixels in length) visible on the lower-left fluke surface near the peduncle junction.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Evidence of irregular erosion and non-uniform trailing edge loss on the right lobe tip; small U-shaped notch visible on the mid-superior edge of the right lobe lobe.
other_distinctive_markers: Specific irregular 'serrated-white' interface on the left lobe tip where the white pigmentation meets the black base.
